restaurantName: InfiniTEA at Conrad London St. James
bio: Treat yourself to a delightful Bottomless Afternoon Tea experience at Conrad London St James - an indulgence without bounds.  Hosted in the elegant, glass-roofed Orchard Room at Conrad London St. James, is an Afternoon Tea lounge filled with delicate and delicious creations that mirror the chic whimsical space. With love seats and mood lighting, it's the perfect destination to enjoy Afternoon Tea.  Their Afternoon Tea menu features freshly baked scones, a selection of delicate savouries, and bespoke pastries. Highlights include the 'Devonshire Bramley apple cake', 'Rhubarb custard tart', and 'Dandelion honey and cobnut delice'.  A vegetarian version of the Afternoon Tea is also available upon request.  Conrad London St. James is just a stone's throw from St. James' Park tube station, within easy reach of some of London's main attractions, including Buckingham Palace and St. James' Park.
pageTitle: InfiniTEA at Conrad London St. James
